name: dsh-local-loopback-trust
description: Opt-in loopback trust for a reverse-proxied DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects globalThis.__DSH_TRANSPORT__ = { ownsHost: true } through the official webserver/index-inject row, so client plugins that gate on Connection.isLoopback (notably Settings → Models) stay functional when the page authority is not a loopback hostname.
